hook.text: Holiday craft fair? Your *cash box* counts.

lines: Lena sells mugs at three December markets.
Cash, app payments, a card reader.
No form shows up for most of it.

beats.sub: of net earnings in a year

beats.text: Write down sales *and* costs that night.
beats.sub: Set part of the cash aside before January 15.

cta.sub: We'll DM you our artist tax guide.

captions.instagram:
Selling at holiday craft fairs and markets this season? The cash box, the card reader and the app payments are all income, with nothing taken out for tax.

✔️ The IRS says you report all income, whether or not a Form 1099-K arrives.
✔️ Net self-employment earnings of $400 or more mean self-employment tax and a return to file.
✔️ Booth fees, materials, packaging and card reader fees are business expenses that lower your profit.
✔️ After each market, write down sales and costs the same night, and set part of the money aside for the January 15, 2027 estimate.

Source: IRS, Understanding your Form 1099-K; Self-employment tax. General information, not advice for your situation.
